headline: The literature SOTA we were chasing was misread. Target is Ooi-2022 varimax_cog, not CogTotalComp.

corrections.truth: not verifiable; the real published SOTA on HCP-YA cognition is 0.627 (F-BERT, arXiv 2609.37642) and 0.571 (co-skewness Tucker, arXiv 2606.04010)
corrections.how_checked: arXiv abstract+full text of both papers

corrections.truth: both papers use the Ooi-2022 varimax_cog composite (PC1 of 58 behavioural measures). Different construct.
corrections.fix: downloaded MMP_HCP_componentscores.csv from ThomasYeoLab/Ooi2022_MMP_HCP and joined on subject id

fbert_replication.estimator: correlation-kernel KRR, doubly-centred train kernel, lambda fixed per row (no test-fold selection)
fbert_replication.verdict: the eigenvalue-power transform reproduces (+0.044 over raw at alpha 0.35). alpha*=0.35 reproduced independently. Best 0.6133 vs SOTA 0.627 = gap 0.014, sd 0.010 = 1.4 SE. NOT YET A WIN.
